title: Induction of HOXA genes in hESC-derived HSPC by two-step differentiation and RA signalling pulse
protocol: Mix 488 mL of Iscove’s DMEM with 90 mL of FBS, 6 mL of Pen/Strep, 6 mL of Glutamax-1, and 9 μL of 2-mercaptoethanol to prepare EB medium.
Use EB medium without cytokines for days 0-4.
Supplement EB medium with 300 ng/mL SCF, 50 ng/mL FLT3-l, and 10 ng/mL BMP4 at day 4.
Continue supplementing EB medium with 300 ng/mL SCF and 50 ng/mL FLT3-l at day 7.
Add 300 ng/mL SCF and 50 ng/mL FLT3-l to the EB medium again at day 10.
Store EB medium without cytokines refrigerated for up to one month.
Store EB medium with cytokines added refrigerated for up to two weeks.
Dissolve 1 mg of Collagenase Type IV in every mL of DMEM/F12 to prepare a hESC Collagenase Solution.
Mix PBS, 2 mL of FBS, 20 mg of Collagenase Type A, 5 mg of Dispase, and 83.3 μg of DNase to make EB dissociation medium.
Store EB dissociation medium refrigerated for up to one week.
Combine 39 mL of MEM alpha with 10 mL of FBS, 500 μL of Pen/Strep, and 500 μL of Glutamine to prepare HSC medium.
Grow 60 10 cm plates of H1 ESCs to ~80% confluency.
Aspirate media from plates.
Wash once with 5 ml of PBS 1X per plate.
Incubate each plate for 10 minutes with 3 mL of hESC collagenase solution in a 37C incubator.
Run the StemPro EZ Passage Disposable Stem Cell Passaging tool gently but firmly around the entire surface area of the plate to detach cells.
Collect cell clumps by washing plates three times each with 3 mL of 5% FBS in PBS 1X, scraping gently to help cells detach further.
Collect washes with cells in 50 mL conical tubes and spin at 1300 rpm for 5 min. at 10C.
Aspirate supernatant after the spin and resuspend pellet in 15 mL 5% FBS in PBS 1X per conical collection tube.
Pool the pellets into as many conical tubes as necessary and spin again to pellet at 1300 rpm for 5 min. at 10C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the pellet in EB medium.

Allocate cells from up to 8 of the 10 cm H1 ESC plates per Ultralow attachment flask or 10 plates per Ultralow 6-well plate and add volume of 40-50 mL of EB medium per flask or 4 mL per well of 6-well plate.
Lift cells into 50 mL conical tubes on day 4 and allow them to settle by gravity for 30 min at room temperature.
Aspirate as much of the supernatant from the loose pellet as possible carefully.
Resuspend in fresh EB media supplemented with 300 ng/mL of SCF, 50 ng/mL of FLT3, and 10 ng/mL BMP4 and redistribute with appropriate volumes to each flask or well of 6-well plate.
Lift cells into 50 mL conical tubes on day 7 and allow them to settle by gravity for 30 min at room temperature.
Aspirate as much of the supernatant from the loose pellet as possible carefully.
Resuspend in fresh EB media supplemented with 300 ng/mL of SCF, 50 ng/mL of FLT3, and 10 ng/mL BMP4 and redistribute with appropriate volumes to each flask or well of 6-well plate.
Lift cells into 50 mL conical tubes on day 10 and allow them to settle by gravity for 30 min at room temperature.
Aspirate as much of the supernatant from the loose pellet as possible carefully.
Resuspend in fresh EB media supplemented with 300 ng/mL of SCF, 50 ng/mL of FLT3 without BMP4 and redistribute with appropriate volumes to each flask or well of 6-well plate.
Leave in incubator until day 14.
Lift cells into 50 mL conical tubes on day 14.
Wash with 10 mL/flask or 1 mL/well of PBS 1X and collect wash in same tubes.
Spin at 1300 rpm for 5 min at 10°C.
Carefully aspirate supernatant and resuspend pellet in a 1:1 ration by volume in PBS 1X with the EB Dissociation Media (2X).
Shake at 200 rpm at 37°C for 15 min.
Filter cells through a 70 μm nylon mesh sterile cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube and count.
Place the mesh strainer in a sterile 6-well plate and add 6 mL of accutase to cover.
Incubate for 5 min. in the 37°C incubator.
Wash the filter into the same 50 mL conical tube with the accutase followed by 10 mL PBS 1X to further dissociate any other cell clumps.
Pass the strained cells through the Dead Cell Removal Kit (Miltenyi Biotec) to collect live cells.
Isolate CD34+ cells obtained from the live cell fraction of the Dead Cell Removal Kit (Miltenyi Biotec).
Irradiate OP9-M2 cells (2000 rad).
Plate irradiated OP9-M2 at a density of 50,000 cells per well of 24-well tissue-culture treated plate in 500 uL of HSC media.
Allow stromal cells to settle for at least 4 hours and use irradiated plates within 3 days of irradiation.
Following at least 4 hours post-stromal cell plating, add 50,000 to 100,000 EB derived CD34+ cells in 500 uL of HSC media to each stroma-layered well.
To control wells, add 10 uL of 100X DMSO dilution.
To AM580 wells, add 10 uL of 100X AM580 dilution.
Every 2-3 days, carefully remove 500 uL of the media from each well without disturbing cell layer on the bottom.
Replace with 500 uL of fresh HSC media containing DMSO at a final dilution of 1:25000 or AM580 at 1:500000 per well.
Remove 900 μL of media from each well on day 6 without disturbing the cell layer.
Replace removed media with 900 μL of fresh HSC media on day 6.
Remove 900 μL of media from each well on day 7 without disturbing the cell layer.
Replace removed media with 900 μL of fresh HSC media on day 7.
Perform half media changes by removing 500 μL of media and replacing it with 500 μL of fresh HSC media every 2-3 days thereafter.
Remove all media from each well to lift cells for analysis.
Strain the cells through a 70 μm cell strainer into 15 mL conical collection tubes.
Incubate the cells in accutase at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Add 500 μL of PBS 1X to the cells and strain them into collection tubes.
Wash the cells with 1 mL/well of PBS 2X, straining washes through a cell strainer into collection tubes.
Spin the cells at 1300 rpm for 5 minutes at 10°C.
Aspirate the supernatant from the spun cells.
Continue tissue culture in the same conditions but without AM580 treatment to assess HSPC expansion.
Proceed immediately to FACS analysis or further experiments to assess HSC molecular and functional properties.
